mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.subtitle: MCP (Model Context Protocol) gives Agents shared external tools. Configure local stdio servers (npx/uvx/node, etc.) or remote SSE / Streamable HTTP endpoints here first; then select which servers each Agent may use in Agent settings. Disabling pauses connections without deleting config. Import/export Claude-style mcpServers JSON — secrets are never written as plaintext.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameHint: Used to distinguish servers in the list; prefer a short Latin identifier.
mcp.commandHint: Allowed launchers (npx, node, uvx, …) or an absolute path; no shell metacharacters.
mcp.deleteConfirm: Delete MCP server “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

provider.title: Add Provider
provider.description: Configure each model vendor here: enter the endpoint address and token (tokens stay in local secure storage and are never written in plaintext), then register the model IDs you want to use. Once saved, they are available to chat and agents. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs are supported.
provider.deleteConfirm: Delete provider “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
provider.deleteBlockedHasModels: This provider still has models. Delete all models before deleting the provider.
provider.apiKeyHintEdit: Leave blank to keep the current token. If filled, replaces the token in local secure storage.
provider.name: Name
provider.nameHint: A label to tell providers apart; only Chinese characters, Latin letters, digits, hyphen, and underscore (e.g. DeepSeek). Not sent to the model API.
provider.baseUrlHint: Must be a valid API root starting with http:// or https:// (port and path allowed). Do not include username, password, or token — e.g. https://api.example.com/v1.
provider.apiKeyHint: Paste the vendor access token (often starts with sk-). Stored only in local secure storage — never in config or exports.
provider.modelsHint: Model ID may only use letters, digits, hyphen, and underscore. Display name follows the same rules as provider name. Context is an optional positive integer with unit K or M (e.g. 128 + K = 128000 tokens).
provider.deleteModelConfirm: Delete model “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

provider.typeHint: Use Anthropic for official Anthropic or Messages API; most gateways use OpenAI. Prefer Anthropic if unsure.
